# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## UI/UX Standards
- Reference: `skills/ui-ux-design/SKILL.md`
- Ensure 4.5:1 contrast ratio, 48dp interactive touch targets, and consistent spacing units (multiples of 4/8px).
- De-emphasize secondary content using weight and tint rather than inflating primary sizes.

## Backend Architecture Standards
- Reference: `skills/backend-architecture/SKILL.md`
- Keep domain entities isolated from frameworks (Spring, Express, Room, Hibernate).
- Methods must be short, cohesive, and have intention-revealing names.
- Favor immutability, builder patterns, and standard collection interfaces.
